title: Screen flow: a run cannot end on a screen that links the records it created (plain-text description, a completed `end` renders nothing, no read-only record-link field)
body:
Filing gate **③ maintainer-directed task**: hotcrm#2285 ruling B (comment 6398567074, the maintainer's 「同意」 2026-10-25T13:58:53Z) orders that "if the platform's screen-flow runner cannot render record links on its end screen, that half is an objectui card first and the HotCRM card carries `Blocked-by:` it (「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」)". Measured below: it cannot. Filed by the hotcrm#2285 card thread (session `session_01HcSvGcpjo74R7vFotCfsrp`, seat `repo:hotcrm#1`).

## Business reason

A screen flow that creates records (HotCRM's lead conversion creates an account, a contact and optionally an opportunity) ends today with a toast and the user left where they started. The browser pass behind hotcrm#2285 measured exactly that on 18.1.0: 「线索转化成功！」, the URL stays on the lead, and nothing points at what was just created; the rep has to know to open the lead's Related tab. Every app with a "create several things in one guided step" flow pays the same tax. Without the capability the ruled HotCRM result screen cannot be authored at all.

## What was measured (installed `@objectstack/*` 18.1.0)

1. **A screen's body text is plain text.** The bundled console (`@objectstack/console` 18.1.0, `dist/assets/urlParams-*.js`) renders `ScreenSpec.description` as a bare React child: `description&&(0,J.jsx)(w,{children:M.description})`. Source today: `packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:639` (`{shown.description && <DialogDescription>{shown.description}</DialogDescription>}`). A markdown link or URL in the template shows as literal text.
2. **A completed `end` renders nothing.** `EndConfigSchema` (`@objectstack/spec` 18.1.0, `src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts`) refuses `message` unless `outcome: 'refused'` ("on a completed end nothing shows it"). On terminal success the runner toasts and calls `onComplete()` (same bundle; source `FlowRunner.tsx` terminal-success branch), so the dialog closes.
3. **No screen field displays a value read-only, let alone as a record link.** `ScreenView.tsx` (`ScreenFieldInput`) renders `lookup` (an editable `LookupField` picker), `select`, `boolean`/`checkbox`, `textarea`/`markdown` (an editable `Textarea`), and a text/number/email/date `Input`. `ScreenFieldConfigSchema` carries no `readonly` key. A pre-filled `lookup` is an input the user can change and must Submit, not a link.

So the only way to "end on a result screen" is a message-only screen whose text cannot link, followed by Submit.

## Expected capability (generic, not product-named)

A screen flow can end by showing the user links to records the run produced, from ids held in flow variables. Two shapes fit the existing pieces; which one (or another) is the platform's call:

- **A read-only record reference on a screen**: a screen field (or display block) that takes an object name and a record id from a value slot and renders the record's display name as a link to its record page, submitting nothing; or
- **A completed `end` that may carry a message with record links**: the completed counterpart of the refused-end notice, shown with Close instead of a toast.

Either needs a contract half in `@objectstack/spec` (a new screen field kind or display key, or relaxing `EndConfigSchema`'s completed-`message` refusal) before the console renders it, so the objectstack spec seat may need a sibling card; this card is the consumer half and the place to decide the shape.

Related, not a duplicate: objectstack#25800 asks for an autolaunched `type: 'flow'` action to NAVIGATE to a record its run created (`onSuccess` on flow actions, flow `output` in the response). This card is about a screen flow showing links on its last screen; a fix for one does not deliver the other.

## Who acts on it

- objectui seat: choose the shape with the spec seat, render it in `FlowRunner` / `ScreenView`.
- Then hotcrm#2285 resumes (its result-screen half is `Blocked-by:` this card) once the capability is in an installable `@objectstack/*` release.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "screen flow end screen completion links to created records FlowRunner result screen" → 1 hit, objectstack-ai/objectui#9973 (closed; a refused end without a screen pause never opened FlowRunner, unrelated). objectstack "flow completion screen record link navigate to created record after screen flow" → 2 hits: #25800 (open, related above), objectstack-ai/objectui#9468 (closed, notification deep link).
